mapper.select: SELECT DICT_ID, MAX(REMARK) AS REMARK FROM com_dict WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY DICT_ID ORDER BY DICT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO com_dict (TENANT_ID, STAT, DICT_ID, DICT_KEY, DICT_VALUE, REL_KEY, ENUM_KEY, SCENE, SORT_NO, REMARK) VALUES (#{dict.tenantId}, #{dict.stat}, #{dict.dictId}, #{dict.dictKey}, #{dict.dictValue}, #{dict.relKey}, #{dict.enumKey}, #{dict.scene}, #{dict.sortNo}, #{dict.remark})
